journey.name: wear no backup
journey.description:
The watch app opts out of Android backup and device transfer, so neither the seed nor the Spark state leaves the watch. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: the dev watch app installed (journeys/wear/README.md › Build and install); no wallet needed. Backend: none. A package that allows backup lists `ALLOW_BACKUP` in its `pkgFlags`, as `adb shell dumpsys package com.google.android.gms | grep -m1 pkgFlags` shows.

actions.action: Run `adb shell dumpsys package to.bitkit.dev | grep -i backup` and verify it prints nothing
Run `adb shell dumpsys package to.bitkit.dev | grep -m1 pkgFlags` and verify the flags do not include `ALLOW_BACKUP`; the debug build prints `pkgFlags=[ DEBUGGABLE HAS_CODE ALLOW_CLEAR_USER_DATA ]`
